summary: Iter 131 RE-TEST of the P0 web-safe alert fix from iter 130. RESULT: The fix DID NOT WORK on the web preview. showAlert / AlertHost combination is still producing zero user-visible feedback for the 4 P0 cases. Verified empirically: (a) /tools/atex Calculate Final Timeline with empty SCC -> no [role=dialog] in DOM, no 'SCC required' text rendered, no window.alert call (hook captured 0). (b) /tools/atex AI with empty title -> same: no modal, no alert. (c) /tools/orgs Create with empty name -> same: no modal, no alert. The AlertHost listener appears to be subscribed (otherwise the showAlert fallbackToBrowser would have called window.alert(title) and the hook would have captured it) but the Modal component never renders queued alerts. PASS items: DEFERRED FLOW 3 (GEM header checkbox icon -> routes to /tools/action-center, confirmed by coordinate-based tap (360,50) since testID is still missing). REGRESSION: ATEX happy-path calculation still works end-to-end (Final Timeline + EE Effort cards rendered after a valid POST /api/atex/estimate). DEFERRED FLOWS 1 + 2 (Solution Finder Values Alignment + Convert-to-Action) were NOT walked end-to-end because validation alerts are still invisible on web, which makes wizard step-error feedback silent and unreliable; the SF Step 1 page renders cleanly with 6-step indicator + life-area chips + smart-goal field + timing block. Login flow works (user dropdown -> harden_1777921741@example.com / HardenPass2026!). All other UI surfaces from iter-130 sweep still load (gem, orgs, atex, solution-finder, action-center).

ui_bugs.issue: The new src/utils/alert.ts + src/components/AlertHost.tsx fix did NOT resolve the P0. Tapping 'Calculate Final Timeline' (empty SCC), tapping 'AI' (empty task title) on /tools/atex, and tapping 'Create' (empty name) on /tools/orgs all produce zero user-visible feedback on the web preview. Empirical proof: (1) No [role='dialog'] / [aria-modal='true'] node appears in DOM after the tap. (2) document.body.innerText does NOT contain 'SCC required', 'Task title required', 'Name required', 'Information', or the message strings. (3) A window.alert hook captures ZERO calls (so the fallbackToBrowser path is NOT firing either, which means listeners.size > 0, so AlertHost IS subscribed — but its <Modal transparent visible> never renders the queued item). (4) No console errors / page errors fire. Likely RCA: react-native-web Modal with transparent+visible flag combined with FontScaleProvider / SafeAreaProvider wrapping may be swallowing the portal mount, OR the setQueue state update is being lost. Suggested debug: add console.log('alertHost queued', req.title) inside _subscribeAlert callback in AlertHost to confirm receipt; if it fires but modal still doesn't show, the issue is the RN-Web Modal portal — switch to a plain <View style={{position:'fixed', zIndex: 99999}}> overlay instead of <Modal>.

Calculate Final Timeline button, AI button, SCC TextInput, Task Title TextInput, Save-as-Template toggle, sub-task title TextInput still have no testID. Test agents continue to rely on placeholder/text selectors which are brittle.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/AlertHost.tsx uses <Modal transparent visible animationType="fade"> (line 82-91). Empirically this Modal does not render the queued AlertRequest on the web preview — verified by DOM inspection (zero [role='dialog'] nodes after triggering showAlert via Calculate/AI/Create buttons). The fix is incomplete; either the Modal isn't mounting due to a portal/parent z-index issue, or setQueue isn't being called. Add a console.log inside _subscribeAlert and inside the Modal component body to triangulate, then swap to a fixed-position <View> overlay for web.

/app/frontend/src/utils/alert.ts fallbackToBrowser() is correctly only called when listeners.size === 0 — but since 0 window.alert calls were captured, the listener IS registered. So the bug is downstream in AlertHost's Modal rendering rather than the alert.ts pub/sub layer.

rca_of_issue: Iter 130 fix attempted to route all Alert.alert calls through a cross-platform showAlert helper which emits to AlertHost (mounted in app/_layout.tsx). Empirical evidence proves the listener IS subscribed (no window.alert fallback fires) but the AlertHost <Modal transparent visible> never renders queued items in the web DOM. Reproduction: open https://repo-blueprint-1.preview.emergentagent.com/tools/atex (logged in), tap 'Calculate Final Timeline' on the empty form -> expected the 'SCC required' modal to appear -> observed nothing in DOM, no [role='dialog'], no window.alert, no console error.
